description: Header file defining utility functions, templates, and macros for Vulkan API integration in PyTorch's ATen library, including hashing, alignment, casting utilities, vector types, and tensor size handling.

methods.name: hash_combine
methods.description: Combines two hash values into one, based on Boost's hash_combine.

methods.name: align_down
methods.description: Aligns a number down to the nearest multiple.

methods.name: align_up
methods.description: Aligns a number up to the nearest multiple.

methods.name: div_up
methods.description: Performs division with ceiling, rounding up.

methods.name: is_negative
methods.description: Checks if a value is negative, considering whether it is signed or unsigned.

methods.name: less_than_lowest
methods.description: Checks if a value is less than the lowest representable value of a limit type.

methods.name: greater_than_max
methods.description: Checks if a value exceeds the maximum of a limit type.

methods.name: overflows
methods.description: Determines if a value overflows the target type during cast.

methods.name: safe_downcast
methods.description: Safely casts a value to a target type, checking for overflow.

methods.name: make_ivec2
methods.description: Constructs a 2D integer vector from a vector of ints, with optional reversal.

methods.name: make_ivec4
methods.description: Constructs a 4D integer vector from a vector of ints, with optional reversal.

methods.name: make_ivec4_prepadded1
methods.description: Constructs a 4D integer vector, padding with ones if input size is less than 4.

methods.name: make_whcn_uvec4
methods.description: Constructs a uvec4 representing tensor dimensions from a vector of sizes.

methods.name: make_whcn_ivec4
methods.description: Constructs an ivec4 representing tensor dimensions from a vector of sizes.

methods.name: multiply_integers
methods.description: Multiplies all integers in a container into an int64_t.

methods.name: create_offset3d
methods.description: Creates a VkOffset3D from a uvec3.

methods.name: create_extent3d
methods.description: Creates a VkExtent3D from a uvec3.
